definitions.gloss: polite; well-mannered; courteous; proper in etiquette
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who follows social etiquette properly and behaves with good manners. A compound i-adjective from 礼儀 (etiquette) + 正しい (correct, proper).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい。
{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To serve customers with courteous manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese people are often praised overseas for being well-mannered.

notes:
USAGE:
{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい is a compound i-adjective describing someone who follows proper etiquette. It can modify nouns or be used predicatively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a polite person)
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (courteous attitude)
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しく⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧ (to greet politely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な means polite or careful, but focuses more on carefulness and thoroughness in actions and speech. ⟦{行儀|ぎょうぎ}→行儀：02662_gyougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ means well-behaved and focuses more on physical conduct.
